Sophia: Quick shoutout — huge thanks to Mira, Jamal, and Keiko for the last-minute fix that kept the demo from going sideways today. You saved my demo 🙏 :tada:
Jamal: So glad it worked! Shout to SRE for the alert. Coffee on me for Sophia at HQ? ☕️
Mira: Team effort — Alex tracked down the perf regression and Eng-ML helped validate the rollback plan. Nice cross-team hustle. :sparkles:
Alex: Happy to help. That rollback script is now... very opinionated 😅
Keiko: Also big kudos to Support — they triaged 3 customer tickets while we were fixing things. Couldn't have done it without that calm triage. :heart:
OncallBot: Incident closed: latency-regression-2026 — resolved by deployment rollback. Duration: 42m.
Sophia: Seriously, you all are tiny heroes. Sending virtual cookies :cookie: — should we do an IRL thank-you lunch next week? Poll: thumbs up for Thursday?
Mira: :thumbsup: Thursday works for me.
Jamal: :thumbsup: Thursday fine here too.
Keiko: :heart: Count me in.
Alex: I'll handle ordering — any dietary restrictions? Happy to bring a GF option. :rocket:
